critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the fuselage window geometry by duplicating the 'Main deck window row' primitive to create a second parallel row offset vertically by 15% of the fuselage height. On this new upper row, insert a vertical gap (0.5m width) at the forward nose position for the passenger door and remove a continuous segment (3m length) near the rear tail to represent the cargo door.
